python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fopen.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old_a = '''    emitter.instruction("ldr x11, [x10, #184]");                                // slot 23 holds the context-property offset PLUS ONE'''
new_a = '''    emitter.instruction(&format!(
        "ldr x11, [x10, #{}]", USER_WRAPPER_VTABLE_CONTEXT_OFFSET
    ));                                                                         // the context-property offset PLUS ONE, in its own quad'''
assert t.count(old_a) == 1
t = t.replace(old_a, new_a)
old_x = '''    emitter.instruction("mov r10, QWORD PTR [r11 + 184]");                      // slot 23 holds the offset PLUS ONE'''
new_x = '''    emitter.instruction(&format!(
        "mov r10, QWORD PTR [r11 + {}]", USER_WRAPPER_VTABLE_CONTEXT_OFFSET
    ));                                                                         // the context-property offset PLUS ONE, in its own quad'''
assert t.count(old_x) == 1
t = t.replace(old_x, new_x)
anchor = 'use super::MIN_WRAPPER_SCHEME_LEN;'
assert t.count(anchor) == 1
t = t.replace(anchor, 'use crate::codegen_support::runtime::data::USER_WRAPPER_VTABLE_CONTEXT_OFFSET;\n' + anchor, 1)
p.write_text(t)
print('fopen.rs: both targets read the context quad')
